headline: Executive order from December 2003 dealing with appointments made during a declared national emergency.
what_it_does: The title shows this order deals with making appointments while a national emergency is in effect. At the time, a national emergency declared after the September 11, 2001 attacks was in place. No summary was provided, so the specific powers, officials, and positions involved cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.group: Officials who make appointments during a national emergency
who_it_affects.how: The order appears to address how or by whom appointments can be made while an emergency is declared, but the details are not given in the source.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 17, 2003; effective date not stated in the source material.
